SINJOH_CABIN.description: Snowy ruins far north of Johto, built long ago by people from Sinnoh and from the Ruins of Alph together. Nobody can Fly in or out.

lines: Hiker: Someone your age, out here? These ruins don't get many visitors.
Look at the carvings: half of them are like Sinnoh's temple, half like the Ruins of Alph.
Two peoples built this place together, long ago. Come warm up in the cabin.
Cynthia: These ruins remind me of home. People from Sinnoh came here and built a temple that felt like Sinnoh.
I can feel a strong power from one of your Poke Balls... one of the Pokemon of myth.
Come to the Mystri Stage. I'll show you what the ruins were built for.

fail: Cynthia: Only Arceus may stand on the stage. Leave your other Pokemon in the cabin's PC first.
lines: Cynthia: The three circles are Dialga, Palkia and Giratina. The middle one is Arceus.
Arceus can call one of them into being. Choose which one.
Arceus steps into the middle circle and the Unown swirl around it.
Light pours over the stage... and an Egg glows on the altar, then cracks.
A glowing orb drifts over to you and takes shape. Dialga joined you!
It came with the Adamant Orb.
fail: Cynthia: Only Arceus may stand on the stage. Leave your other Pokemon in the cabin's PC first.

lines: Cynthia: Arceus, the Unown and these ruins... they're all connected somehow.
The Unown brought you here. Learn more of their forms and they may open the way again.
Half of the Unown for a second dragon, all of them for the third. That's what the carvings say.

travel_options.message: The old man's Abra glows... and you're home in New Bark Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Sinjoh Ruins
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Bring Arceus to the Ruins of Alph. The Unown may take you somewhere far away.
